svg.title: Caddy same-origin proxy connections
svg.desc: Inputs, outputs, durable state, evidence, failure, and recovery relationships for Caddy same-origin proxy.

a.xlink:title: PhotoPrism. Provides the verified managed photo application under a same-origin Caddy path.
React / Vite PWA. Renders Lite screens and sends same-origin requests only to FastAPI through Caddy.
FastAPI /api/lite/*. Validates requests, owns safe read APIs, admits commands, and never delegates browser execution directly to NATS or shell.
Atomic PWA promotion. Promotes a verified staged PWA atomically and keeps the previous release available for rollback.
Caddy same-origin proxy. Serves the PWA and routes /api/lite/* and managed app paths without exposing backend secrets.
Local LAN. Provides local-device access to the same-origin Caddy endpoint without hardcoded addresses.
